[9PM] #LagosIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Movement from Adekunle intersection on 3rd Mainland Bridge to Sura, Simpson Bridge, and Osborne is free-flowing. 
Similarly, traffic is smooth on Obalende Bridge to CMS Bridge, Apongbon Bridge, and from Apongbon Bridge to Nitel Intersection and Bonny Camp. 
Awolowo Road to Obalende Bridge and Simpson Bridge is also clear, and traffic from Ilubirin to Carter Bridge and 3rd Mainland Bridge is moving well. 
With officers on ground monitoring traffic, there's no congestion or impediments within the axis.

#FollowLASTMA
